verdict.rationale: Oneleet's integrations pull user-access data from connected apps: GitHub user access, AWS IAM users and Google Workspace user accounts. Controls can hold evidence and review history, which is adjacent groundwork for access reviews. However, nothing documents a dedicated user access review workflow. Missing for 10: scheduled or periodic access review campaigns, in-app reviewer sign-off, automatic filing of the review artifact into an evidence library, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
